name: searchcarriers-watchdog
description: Carrier watch list management, change alerts, alert routing to Slack/Telegram/email, and compliance drift monitoring.

tools.name: manage_watchlist
tools.description: Add, remove, or list carriers on the Carrier Watch monitoring list.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: Pull recent Carrier Watch alerts for safety, insurance, and authority changes.

tools.name: route_alert
tools.description: Push alerts to Slack, Telegram, email, or webhook endpoints.

tools.name: monitor_compliance
tools.description: Detect compliance drift over time for watched carriers.
